title: bandit weekly with no filter and the inline-suppression ledger (plan 10 row 10G-39, OT-1 of review 21)
note: found while reviewing the 14 nosec and 8 noqa: S lines on master f6c42230 for tools/inline_suppressions.yaml; the code line is unchanged and its ledger entry is a finding, not safe

findings.claim: the DTD and entity guard of the ICD-10 XML reader checks the raw bytes for <!DOCTYPE and <!ENTITY; a UTF-16 document holds neither as bytes, passes the guard, and ElementTree expands its internal entity
findings.expected: a document that declares a DTD or an entity is refused whatever its encoding
findings.happened: a UTF-16 document with an internal entity is parsed and the entity expanded (expat 2.9.0); external entities are not fetched by ElementTree and expat's amplification limits still apply
